title: 生涯スポーツ演習(ゴルフ)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports(Golf)

keywords: Lifelong sports 2.The fun of sports 3.Competition planning and management 4.Health 5.Lifestyle
educationalGoal: By studying the fundamental skills of sports, students will learn the following: 1. The enjoyment of sports throughout their lifetime. 2. The knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on the Plan-Do-Check-Action (PDCA) cycle. 3. Necessities for social/student life such as the observation of rules, respect and kindness for others, a competitive spirit, leadership/cooperation, a sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: Students will learn the following things in this basic golf course.1.Knowledge aboutgolf:(1) Competition characteristics, clubs and terminology of golf (2) Safety instructions for golf2. Fundamental skills of golf(1)Grip and Swing (2) Shots using iron clubs (3)Approach shots and putting3.How to play in golf course(1) Rules and manner of golfing (2) Knowledge that is necessary when we play golf in a golf course.Others:・100 minutes class will be held once a week・Students are required to prepare clothes for sports/golf including golf gloves・Because learning activities will be evaluated, students will be required to participate in all learning programs, and have to manage the physical condition by oneself.・For ensuring safety during golf lesson, and protection of your palm, use a golf glove
requiredKnowledge: Understanding about appropriate mental and physical attitudes during sports activities Understanding about safety management during sports activitie

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying a sports life throughout their own lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills of sports and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain their own situation and improvements in sports activities based on PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and improvements for a healthy life by self-evaluating daily life habits.
Be able to understand safety management in sports activities, and to implement them in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental sports skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental sports skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3) Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: 1.Course guidance for understanding the outlines of class 2.Competition properties and clubs in golf 3. Fundamental skills of golf a. Grip b. Swing (using iron club #9) 4.Make a self-assessment sheet on learning activity
lessons.operation: Lecture and practical skill 1.Distributing some documents including syllabus 2.Students will be divided into a few groups
lessons.assignments: 1. Reading the distributed documents 2. Review on the fundamental skills (Grip & Swing) 3. life habits of the week

lessons.content: 1.Drill and review of swing skill using club #9
lessons.operation: Class will be held at the golf range in Amaike; students will perform drills with a buddy.
lessons.assignments: 1. Portfolio report on weekly life habits; students should submit two portfolio reports by the designated days.

lessons.content: 1. Drill and review of swing skills using a 9-iron 2. Approach shot with a pitching wedge (PW) 3 .Make a self-assessment sheet on learning activities
lessons.operation: Students will perform drills in designated areas.
lessons.assignments: 1. Review on the fundamental skills (swing and shots) 2. Portfolio report on weekly life habits

lessons.content: 1. Drill and review of swing skills using a 9-iron and PW 2. Putting and putters 3. Make a self-assessment sheet on learning activities
lessons.operation: 1. Students will perform drills in designated areas 2. Videos of shots will be recording using smartphones
lessons.assignments: 1. Preparation for writing a report on swing, shots, and clubs 2. Portfolio report on weekly life habits

lessons.content: 1. Drill and review of swing skills using a 9-iron, PW, and putter 2. Make a self-assessment sheet on learning activities
lessons.operation: 1. Students will perform drills in designated areas 2. Videos of shots will be recording using smartphones 3. Practical skills test will evaluate fundamental skills
lessons.assignments: 1. Report on swing, shots, and clubs to be submitted by the designated day 2. Portfolio report on weekly life habits Students should submit all assignments by the designated day.

lessons.content: 1. Golf etiquette 2. Target-bird golf (TBG) 3. Make a self-assessment sheet on learning activities
lessons.operation: 1. Students will play TBG on a designed course. Note: In the case of bad weather, TBG will be played as putter golf in the gymnasium.

lessons.content: 1. Review of golf etiquette by playing TBG 2. Check the results and records of learning activities 3. Questionnaire survey 4. Survey on student health status
lessons.operation: 1. Students will play TBG on a designed course. Note: In the case of bad weather, TBG will be played as putter golf in the gymnasium.
